correctness.rationale: The diagonal example is an exact g-Bessel sequence. Its synthesis operator is T=diag(1/n), its Gram operator is T*T=diag(1/n^2), and the explicit vector (1/n^2) lies in R(T*) but not R(T*T). The exact closed-range boundary follows from Douglas factorization and the spectral gap of T*T; no finite experiment is used.
